ruleName: Ball Lost or Out of Bounds: Stroke-and-Distance Relief
group: Ball Lost or Out of Bounds, Provisional Ball
title: How Long May You Search for a Ball?
question: Your tee shot disappears into long rough. You and your playing partners begin searching for the ball. How long are you allowed to search before the ball is officially lost?

choices.text: As long as you keep up with the group in front.

explanation: A player has 3 minutes to search for a ball. The search time begins when the player or their caddie starts searching for it, not when the ball was played. If the ball is not found and identified within those 3 minutes, it is lost, and the player must proceed under stroke and distance unless another Rule applies. (Rule 18.2a(1))
